description: This file defines an IdentityFilter class that acts as a transparent passthrough filter for frame processing within a pipeline, forwarding frames unchanged for testing and composition purposes.

classes.name: IdentityFilter
classes.description: A pass-through filter that forwards all frames without modification, acting as a transparent conduit within the processing pipeline.

methods.description: Initializes the IdentityFilter, passing additional keyword arguments to the parent FrameProcessor class.
